content.tex: INVESTIGATION NUMBER WALLS
This investigation looks at what happens when you place numbers on a Number Wall.
You make a Number Wall like this.
\(\bullet\) Integers are put on the bottom row of bricks.
\(\bullet\) The number on a brick is the sum of the numbers on the two bricks below.
Examples
Total \(=\quad 5\) Total \(=\quad 2\)
\(1\quad 4\quad -5\quad 7\)
Total \(=\quad 8\)
\(1\quad 2\quad 3\)
Complete this Number Wall.
